about: Every screen name scripts/store-screenshots-android.sh home captures for Tenshu Home — Android only: Home has no App Store listing and no iOS walk, so `captured` (the iOS list) is empty and `android.captured` is the list. The devices come from a desktop Tenshu Hub the run starts with its simulated devices under ordinary names, paired through Control; both automations are made in Home's own editor (docs/how-to/store-screenshots.md §8.2). Adding a capture means adding it here.

android.about: The Android pipeline (scripts/store-screenshots-android.sh home, walk in scripts/lib/android_shots.py) captures these on a 1080x2400 phone AVD, light only, keyed android/phone/<lang>/NN-screen.

01-devices.shows: Devices: the Hub, its storage, the device bridge, the living-room lamp switched on and dimmed, and the bedroom climate sensor

02-automations.shows: Automations: Evening lights and Lights out

03-automation.shows: The automation editor: Evening lights, 15 minutes before sunset, turn on the living-room lamp
